name.description: Display name of the homebrew application as shown in the catalog.

author.description: Name of the application author or primary maintainer.

description_short.description: Brief one-line summary of the application, up to 160 characters. Displayed in catalog listings.
examples: The swiss army knife of GameCube homebrew
Disc Backup Tool for GC/Wii Discs

description_long.description: Extended description of the application, up to 500 characters. Displayed on the application detail page.
examples: Swiss is an all-in-one homebrew utility for the Nintendo GameCube. It allows browsing and loading DOL executables and GCM disc images from various storage devices.

category.description: Category the application belongs to. Must be one of: games, emulators, utilities, demos, media.

platforms.description: List of compatible hardware platforms. If omitted, no platform compatibility is specified.

peripherals.description: List of supported or required peripherals and accessories.

source.description: Defines where to download the application binary. Supports GitHub releases, GitLab releases, or a direct URL.

oneOf.description: Download from a GitHub release asset.

asset_pattern.description: Glob pattern to match the desired release asset filename.

ignore_versions.description: List of release tag names to skip when resolving the latest version.

oneOf.description: Download from a direct URL. Used when the application is not hosted on a Git forge.

url.description: Direct download URL of the application binary or archive.

file_name.description: Override the filename derived from the URL. Useful when the URL does not contain a meaningful filename.

oneOf.description: Download from a GitLab release asset.

asset_pattern.description: Glob pattern to match the desired release asset filename.

ignore_versions.description: List of release tag names to skip when resolving the latest version.

oneOf.description: Download from itch.io. Used for applications and games hosted on the itch.io platform.

creator.description: itch.io username of the creator. Appears in the URL as https://[creator].itch.io/[game].

game.description: itch.io game/project slug. Appears in the URL as https://[creator].itch.io/[game].

upload.description: Display name of the upload to download, as shown on the itch.io download page.

format.description: Expected file format of the download.

treatments.description: Ordered list of post-download processing steps applied to the downloaded asset. Treatments are executed sequentially.

treatment.description: Name of the treatment operation to apply. Common treatments: archive.extract (extract an archive), contents.move (move/rename files).

arguments.description: Arguments passed to the treatment. The meaning depends on the treatment type. For archive.extract: [source_pattern, destination]. For contents.move: [source_pattern, destination].
